_comment: The four sogood tenants whose findings have been confirmed by hand against
the live pages -- three on the platform's subdomains and one on its own
apex domain, so discovery, the fast lane and the browser lane are all
exercised the way a real run exercises them.
Every rule quoted in docs/CAPABILITIES.md is backed by output from these
Sized to run on a modest laptop: ONE Chromium worker (the browser lane is
memory-bound at ~300MB/worker, not CPU-bound) and 6 pages per site. The
committed examples came from a 10-page-per-site pass, so a rule that only
fires deeper in a site may be absent here; `npm run examples` says so
loudly rather than quietly shipping a shorter page. Add --no-lighthouse to
drop roughly 80% of the browser lane's cost when iterating.
Deliberately NOT seeded with https://sogood.business/: its sitemap is a
<sitemapindex> that expands into 357 tenants, which is the pilot's job, not
